ms.promise: Comprehensive and user-friendly public documentation on the Optim DAO Stack will be published hosted on GitBook. This information repository will provide non-technical users the resources necessary to familiarize themselves with the DAO tooling, its capabilities and its intended use cases. This documentation will enable the community to leverage and implement the features and modules of the ODAO Stack, once live, across autonomous organizations in the ecosystem.
ms.criteria:
A comprehensive documentation repository hosted on GitBook that details the capabilities and functionalities of the Optim DAO Stack software. These educational resources will cater to non-technical users as the main source of information for not only learning how to utilize the ODAO toolkit but to understand the system design decisions that sets it apart from existing alternatives and how novel features being introduced will be used to propel the quality and impact of DAO governance on Cardano.
